sources.title: Tashkil: AI-Enhanced Arabic Tool
sources.snippet: Simplify your Arabic learning journey with our comprehensive tool. Enjoy features like accurate Tashkil (تشكيل) - also known as Tashkeel or Harakat, multi-language translation, grammar analysis, voice-over pronunciation, text conversion from screenshots, and PDF processing. Enhance your understanding and proficiency in Arabic effortlessly.
